package partyroom

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"
)

const t0 int64 = 1800000000000

func TestPartyGameRulesValidateAndRoomCode(t *testing.T) {
	if err := DemoRules().Validate(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for name, mutate := range map[string]func(*Rules){
		"nine seats":         func(r *Rules) { r.Capacity = MaxSeats + 1 },
		"one seat":           func(r *Rules) { r.Capacity, r.MinPlayers = 1, 1 },
		"star after round":   func(r *Rules) { r.StarMaxMillis = r.RoundMillis },
		"deadline too short": func(r *Rules) { r.MatchMillis = int64(r.Rounds)*r.RoundMillis - 1 },
		"loser paid more":    func(r *Rules) { r.PlayReward = r.WinReward + 1 },
	} {
		r := DemoRules()
		mutate(&r)
		if !errors.Is(r.Validate(), ErrRule) {
			t.Fatalf("%s: invalid rules accepted", name)
		}
		if _, err := NewMatchRoom("m", []int64{1, 2}, r, 1, t0); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: room opened with invalid rules", name)
		}
	}
	for _, unique := range []int64{1, 35, 36, 1 << 40} {
		code := EncodeCode(unique)
		if got, err := DecodeCode(code); err != nil || got != unique {
			t.Fatalf("code %q decoded to %d, %v", code, got, err)
		}
	}
	for _, bad := range []string{"", "0", "-1", "ZZZZZZZZZZZZZ", "A B"} {
		if _, err := DecodeCode(bad); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("bad code %q accepted", bad)
		}
	}
	if _, err := NewMatchRoom("m", []int64{1, 1}, DemoRules(), 1, t0); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("duplicate roster accepted")
	}
	if _, err := Decode(""); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("empty state decoded")
	}
}

// 心跳是可变步长：一拍可能隔 100ms，也可能掉拍后隔几秒，或者进程卡顿后一次推进到很久以后。
// 同一组输入，按不同步长推进到同一时刻，状态必须逐字节相同；事件按时间顺序结算（宽限到期 → 回合结束 → 硬期限）。
func TestPartyGameRulesVariableStepEquivalence(t *testing.T) {
	play := func(steps []int64, end int64) State {
		t.Helper()
		s, err := NewMatchRoom("m-1", []int64{11, 12, 13}, DemoRules(), 42, t0)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		for i, id := range []int64{11, 12, 13} {
			if err := s.Connect(id, uint64(i+1), true, t0); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		// 13 第一回合就断线、不再回来：宽限到期的时刻固定在 t0+100+Grace。
		if err := s.Connect(13, 3, false, t0+100); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		now := t0
		advanceTo := func(target int64) {
			for _, step := range steps {
				if now+step > target {
					break
				}
				now += step
				s.Advance(now)
			}
			now = target
			s.Advance(now)
		}
		advanceTo(s.StarAt)
		if _, _, err := s.Apply(11, Input{Epoch: 1, Seq: 1, Round: 1, Kind: "grab"}, now); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		advanceTo(end)
		return s
	}
	end := t0 + 3*DemoRules().RoundMillis + 1
	want := play(nil, end) // 一步到位
	if want.Phase != PhaseSettled || want.Result != ResultWon || want.Winner != 11 || want.SettledAt != t0+3*DemoRules().RoundMillis {
		t.Fatalf("one-step outcome %+v", want)
	}
	if want.Seats[2].Out != OutDropped {
		t.Fatal("grace expiry not applied")
	}
	for _, steps := range [][]int64{{100}, {50}, {100, 100, 2300, 100, 900}, {7000}} {
		if got := play(steps, end); got.Encode() != want.Encode() {
			t.Fatalf("steps %v diverged:\n got %s\nwant %s", steps, got.Encode(), want.Encode())
		}
	}
	// 进程卡顿后第一次推进已经越过硬期限：仍按时间顺序先结束第三回合（唯一领先者胜），不能被期限抢先判成 timeout。
	if late := play(nil, t0+10*DemoRules().MatchMillis); late.Encode() != want.Encode() {
		t.Fatalf("advance past the deadline reordered events:\n got %s\nwant %s", late.Encode(), want.Encode())
	}
	// 平分：常规回合打完进入加时，一直到硬期限按 timeout 结算，结算时刻是期限本身而不是“发现”的时刻。
	tie, _ := NewMatchRoom("m-2", []int64{21, 22}, DemoRules(), 7, t0)
	for i, id := range []int64{21, 22} {
		_ = tie.Connect(id, uint64(i+1), true, t0)
	}
	tie.Advance(t0 + 3*DemoRules().RoundMillis)
	if tie.Phase != PhasePlaying || tie.Round != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("tie did not go to sudden death: %+v", tie)
	}
	tie.Advance(t0 + 10*DemoRules().MatchMillis)
	if tie.Result != ResultTimeout || tie.SettledAt != t0+DemoRules().MatchMillis || tie.Winner != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("deadline settlement %+v", tie)
	}
	if tie.Advance(t0 + 20*DemoRules().MatchMillis) {
		t.Fatal("settled room kept advancing")
	}
}
